task.name: Task
task.description: Individual work items that move the project forward

fields.name: Title
fields.aiInstruction: A clear, actionable task title

fields.name: Owner
fields.aiInstruction: Assign to the team member responsible

fields.name: Notes
fields.aiInstruction: Relevant context, dependencies, or rationale

fields.name: Owner
fields.aiInstruction: Who is responsible for unblocking this?

risk.name: Risk
risk.description: Known risks to the project's success, with likelihood, impact, and mitigation plans

fields.name: Risk
fields.aiInstruction: Clear description of what could go wrong

fields.name: Severity
fields.aiInstruction: How bad would it be if this risk materialises

fields.name: Likelihood
fields.aiInstruction: How likely is this risk to materialise

fields.name: Impact
fields.aiInstruction: What happens if this risk materialises — specific consequences to timeline, outcome, or team

fields.name: Mitigation
fields.aiInstruction: What can be done to reduce likelihood or impact

fields.name: Owner
fields.aiInstruction: Who is responsible for monitoring and mitigating this risk

decision.name: Decision
decision.description: Decisions made during the project — who decided what, when, and why

fields.name: Context
fields.aiInstruction: Why was this decision made? What alternatives were considered?

open_question.name: Open Question
open_question.description: Questions that need answers — tracked by criticality and status

fields.name: Question
fields.aiInstruction: The specific question that needs answering

fields.name: Criticality
fields.aiInstruction: decision_critical = must be resolved before committing further. important = should be resolved early. longer_term = can be resolved during execution.

fields.name: Answer
fields.aiInstruction: The answer once resolved, with source and date

fields.name: Notes
fields.aiInstruction: Additional context or why this question matters

idea.name: Idea
idea.description: Raw ideas, instincts, and possibilities to return to later. Not all ideas become tasks — some are strategic bets, some are hypotheses, some are parking-lot items.

fields.name: Title
fields.aiInstruction: Clear, concise name for this idea

fields.name: Description
fields.aiInstruction: What the idea is, why it matters, and any initial thinking on how it could work

fields.name: Status
fields.aiInstruction: raw = just captured. developing = being refined. ready_to_execute = has enough shape to become tasks. parked = good idea, not now. promoted = converted to tasks.

fields.name: Dependencies
fields.aiInstruction: What needs to be true before this idea can be executed?

diagram.name: Diagram
diagram.description: Visual diagrams — architecture, timelines, org charts, dependency maps

fields.name: Title
fields.aiInstruction: Concise name for this diagram

fields.name: Description
fields.aiInstruction: What this diagram shows and why it's useful

fields.name: Mermaid Code
fields.aiInstruction: Valid Mermaid diagram syntax (graph, flowchart, sequence, gantt, etc.)

glossary.name: Glossary
glossary.description: Terms, tools, concepts, and acronyms used in this project

fields.name: Term
fields.aiInstruction: The term or acronym

fields.name: Definition
fields.aiInstruction: Clear, concise explanation in the context of this project

fields.name: Aliases
fields.aiInstruction: Alternative names or acronyms for the same thing
